title: Control Register
body:
Write-only, from the [[CPU]]'s point of view: the register an [[I-O Interface]] exposes so
software can *configure* the device. Setting a [[Baud Rate]], choosing parity, enabling or
disabling interrupts from this device, starting a transfer. Nothing here is data; it is
all "here is how you should behave".

The other two are the [[Data Register]] (what moves) and the [[Status Register]] (what the
device reports back).
